# NNM-Club fixtures

All files are independently hand-written, not saved tracker HTML.
`forum-topic.html` models structural observations from a single authorized
live diagnostic on 2026-09-13: a self-topic `a.maintitle` inside h1, relative
`download.php?id=<attachment-id>`, and a Windows-1251 meta declaration.
Titles, topic IDs, attachment IDs and body text are synthetic. No cookies,
account data, clearance tokens or private page dumps are retained.

The fixture source is UTF-8 for repository readability; tests explicitly encode
it to Windows-1251 before passing bytes to the plugin, matching its declaration.
Existing `topic.html` preserves regression coverage of the earlier markup.
